declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
 nullchk;
 --
 -- Check that effective date is >= today
 --
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT', 'CHANGED') then
 if trunc(:alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date) < trunc(v_local_time) then
 show_error('2312');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date < :alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date and 
 :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date is not null then
 --next_item;
 show_error('2314');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUP_RECORDS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_dup_records (t_cur_rec in varchar2) is
 t_key_data_grade alt_id_donor_grade.key_data_grade%type;
 t_altid_match_type alt_id_donor_grade.altid_match_type%type;
 t_final_grade alt_id_donor_grade.final_grade%type;
 t_eff_date alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date%type;
 t_term_date alt_id_donor_grade.term_date%type;
 t_dup_found varchar2(1);
 v_sysdate date;
begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 go_record(to_number(t_cur_rec));
 t_key_data_grade := :alt_id_donor_grade.key_data_grade;
 t_altid_match_type := :alt_id_donor_grade.altid_match_type;
 t_final_grade := :alt_id_donor_grade.final_grade;
 t_eff_date := :alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date;
 t_term_date := :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date;
 
 first_record;
 t_dup_found := 'N';
 loop
 if :system.cursor_record != t_cur_rec then
 if :alt_id_donor_grade.key_data_grade = t_key_data_grade and
 :alt_id_donor_grade.altid_match_type = t_altid_match_type and
 :alt_id_donor_grade.final_grade = t_final_grade then
 t_dup_found := 'Y'; -- Added by Kishore on 10/28/2013. IM 9765
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 10/28/2013. IM 9765
 if t_eff_date between :alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date and nvl(:alt_id_donor_grade.term_date, t_eff_date + 10) then
 t_dup_found := 'Y';
 else
 if t_term_date is null then
 if :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date is null then
 t_dup_found := 'Y';
 else
 if (:alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date between t_eff_date and nvl(t_term_date, :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date + 10)) or
 (:alt_id_donor_grade.term_date between t_eff_date and nvl(t_term_date, :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date + 10)) then
 t_dup_found := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;
 else -- if t_term_date is not null
 if :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date is null then
 if (t_eff_date between :alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date and :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date) or
 (t_term_date between :alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date and nvl(:alt_id_donor_grade.term_date, t_term_date + 10)) then
 t_dup_found := 'Y';
 end if;
 else
 if :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date >= trunc(v_sysdate) and t_term_date >= trunc(v_sysdate) then
 if (t_eff_date between :alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date and :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date) or
 (t_term_date between :alt_id_donor_grade.eff_date and :alt_id_donor_grade.term_date) then
 t_dup_found := 'Y';
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if; -- if t_term_date is null then
 end if;
 -- End of commented section */
 end if;
 end if;
 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 
 go_record(t_cur_rec);
 
 if t_dup_found = 'Y' then
 show_error('13002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
